dispositions.summary: The Agent Platform backend is new in firebase 12.19.0 and has no production capture yet, so the sandbox does not route it; implementing it is tracked in #1674.

Live API is deferred, not out of scope — it is a bidirectional websocket protocol the sandbox can model with a scripted session engine, the same seam pattern the REST plane already uses; the work has not happened yet.
Deferred with the rest of the Live API family — the browser audio helper rides the Live session seam once that lands.
Server-side templates are deferred, not out of scope — hosting template state is exactly the kind of server infrastructure the sandbox exists to model; the template store has not been built yet.
